generation.anatomical_axis: +Z bill/front, X bilateral width, Y up

identity_features: rounded lemon-yellow breast and pale rump
small head with black breeding cap and paired dark eyes
separate bilateral black folded wings with white bars
two thin pink legs with six gripping toes and dark claws

subject.description: Native volumetric male American goldfinch with rounded yellow body, black cap and barred folded wings, pointed bill, tapered tail, and gripping feet
uncertainties: The supplied photograph is one cropped side view; far-side markings and tail length are conservative bilateral inference
The source-facing silhouette metric excludes legs because the reference foot is occluded by a branch and the tail is cropped
No projected photograph skin is used; hidden surfaces use semantic pixel materials
